rule: first prohibited UAV-environment contact during the episode = failure; landing-gear contact with the designated landing surface inside its footprint during the land beat is allowed; internal UAV pairs are ignored
monitor_verified_by: the resting landing-gear contact on the take-off surface was reported during initialization

physics.judged: after every physics step, outside the PhysX callback

landing_exception.note: Forest landing clearings are unmarked spots on the shared terrain mesh: the supporting collider is /World/Terrain, so every contact point must also lie within radius_m of the pad centre
